title: VTC Events — Registrations — Register — payload
description: A member registers for an event, or changes their registration: going or maybe, how many guests, their answers to the event's questions, and the code of conduct they acknowledge. The community decides whether that makes them going, pending a host's decision or waitlisted, and its signed answer is the member's receipt. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

status.description: What the member says. Only `going` or `maybe`: whether `going` makes them going, pending or waitlisted is the community's to decide (VTI-EVT-031 – 033). To stop going, use vtc/events/registrations/withdraw.

guests.description: Plus-ones the member brings, at most the event's `plusOnes`. Absent means 0 on a new registration and unchanged on a change.

answers.description: Answers to the event's questions, keyed by `questionId`. On a change, the answers given replace the ones held; absent leaves them unchanged.

codeOfConductAcknowledged.description: The `sha256` of the event's code of conduct, which the member read and acknowledges. REQUIRED by the community where the event names one (VTI-EVT-035).

presentation.description: Only from a party who is not a member of this community, for an event whose audience names partners: their presentation of the membership credential a named partner issued them (VTI-EVT-132). Verified before, and without reference to, the event; discarded once decided (VTI-EVT-133).

Response.title: VTC Events — Registrations — Register — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/registrations/register/0.2 request: the member's receipt (VTI-EVT-092). Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/registrations/register/0.2#response.

registration.description: The registration as it now stands: `going`, `maybe`, `pending` or `waitlisted`, with the roster setting it was made under.

event.description: The event as it stood when the community answered.

wasCreated.description: True when this request created the registration rather than changing one held.
